findings: Source is Imperial Brands PLC Annual Report and Accounts 2025 (Companies House company number 03236483); extract covers only early Strategic Report pages (~1–10) and ends before Operating review (p.28), Financial review (p.76), group financial statements, notes and shareholder information listed in contents.
Figures are presented in sterling (£); reporting currency is not explicitly labelled in this excerpt but all monetary amounts use £/bn.
FY25 Tobacco & NGP net revenue £8.3 billion vs reported (duty-inclusive) revenue £32.2 billion — source_path: ch_03236483_MzUwMzU1MzMxOGFkaXF6a2N4.txt.
FY25 Tobacco & NGP net revenue regional split: Europe 42%, Americas 35%, AAACE (Africa, Asia, Australasia and Central/Eastern Europe) 23%.
Five priority combustible markets (USA, Germany, UK, Spain, Australia) represent c.70% of adjusted tobacco operating profit; company presence in 100+ countries.
FY25 NGP net revenue growth 13.7%; strategy commits to annual double-digit NGP net revenue growth.
Priority-market net revenue proportions (FY25): USA 35%, Germany OCR ‘| 1%’ (likely 11%), UK 6%, Spain 5%, Australia 2%.
Priority-market combustible share movements (FY25): Germany +45 bps, UK −85 bps, Spain −45 bps, Australia +20 bps; USA movement OCR-corrupted (‘lbp’).

NGP category FY25 market-share gains cited: vapour UK +160 bps; heated Italy +60 bps; modern oral OCR ‘T30 bps’ (unclear). NGP footprint focused US/Europe; modern oral in US/Nordics, vaping in Western Europe, heated in southern/eastern Europe.

March 2025: five-year evolved strategy to 2030 announced — drive sustainable combustibles value in five markets; build NGP scale; enablers include consumer/brand capabilities, high-performance culture, simplified data-led organisation.

No statutory or adjusted operating profit, EBIT, EPS, net income, tax charge, cash flow, capex, FCF, net debt, lease liabilities, dividends, buybacks, share count, pension, goodwill/impairment, litigation/contingencies, excise payables, working-capital commentary, combustibles volume/price/mix bridge, or FY outlook guidance appear in this truncated body.
